generatedProse.practice-connection: Across the School of Sport, reflecting on experience is a habit every subject runs on. A sport and exercise science student on a lab placement, a coaching student running a session and a therapy student in a rehab clinic all learn by doing. Each one asks you to look back at what you did, work out what it taught you, and act differently. Treat what follows as being about your own placements, sessions and reflective logs across the school, not about study in the abstract.
